stances.summary: Highlights campaign momentum ahead of November election
stances.quote: It was great meeting so many voters in Detroit and seeing the energy behind the coalition that will win this November.

stances.summary: Challenges assumption that South Carolina is permanently Republican
stances.quote: There is no such thing as a permanently red state, county, or district - something South Carolina has the potential to demonstrate in November.

stances.summary: Argues voters share common ground despite political polarization
stances.quote: It's all too easy to feel politically alone right now - but most of us actually agree on the big things we must do to make life better in this country.

stances.summary: Calls for flipping Indiana and delivering better life for Hoosiers
stances.quote:
This is the year to flip the narrative, change the balance of political power, and deliver a better life for Hoosiers.

I’m proud to be in their corner - and to see them proving that when we show up and give people something worth voting for, we can compete anywhere.

stances.summary: Argues voters seek leaders with deep roots and integrity
stances.quote: And as I’ve traveled the country this year, I’m more convinced than ever that voters - including in the state where I grew up - are hungry for leaders with the deep roots, vision, integrity, and energy this moment requires.

stances.summary: Asserts Indiana is not permanently Republican, cites past Democratic wins
stances.quote:
There’s no such thing as a permanently “red” state, and that's certainly true of Indiana.

I've seen how great Hoosier Democrats can surprise the pundits and win, in uphill districts and statewide.

stances.summary: Endorses Rebecca candidate for Congress, criticizes Derrick Van Orden's constituent avoidance
stances.quote: I first met @rebeccaforwi.bsky.social at a town hall in La Crosse back in January, where people were incredibly discouraged by Derrick Van Orden’s refusal to face his own constituents. Rebecca will never turn her back on the people she serves - and I’m proud to support her in thi

stances.summary: Endorses Luke Bronin for Congress as having energy and vision needed
stances.quote: @lukebronin.bsky.social has the energy and vision that Democrats need in Congress, and I'm proud to be counted among his supporters in this campaign. He's ready to get to work to fix our broken political system and deliver for his community. Onward to November!

stances.summary: Dismisses Trump's distractions, refocuses on substantive election issues
stances.quote:
Cats! Dogs! Geese! Laura Loomer! Look, now he’s attacking Taylor! 

Like the last season before a show gets canceled for getting over-the-top and, at the same time, boring. 

This election is about jobs, wages, climate, health care, abortion. Not his show. Your life.

stances.summary: Praises Harris debate performance, emphasizes substance over spectacle
stances.quote:
Substance over bluster. 

Optimism over negativity. 

And yes, a new generation over the same, old, tired show. 

She crushed it tonight.

stances.summary: Contrasts Harris focus on voters versus Trump's self-focus
stances.quote:
All night he talked about himself and about her. 

She, by contrast, talked about you. 

Because that’s who she works for.

stances.summary: Endorses Tim Walz as VP pick, praises his experience and values
stances.quote: Tim Walz is an exceptionally effective governor - and also great to work with. I’m excited for what his Midwestern voice, military experience, and common-sense values will bring to our winning ticket, and for everything the Harris-Walz administration will deliver for Americans.

stances.summary: Criticizes Republican record on Epstein files, Medicaid cuts, SNAP, tariffs
stances.quote:
Republicans are losing because they can't run on their record. 

They can't run on covering up the Epstein files. 
They can't run on cutting Medicaid.
They can't run on stripping SNAP or imposing tariffs. 

Americans see what is happening - and we are hungry for change.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump for pursuing illegal political revenge over governance
stances.quote:
That’s illegal, so the courts stopped him. 

Now he's appealing. America deserves so much better than a President putting political revenge ahead of jobs and safety.

stances.summary: Accuses Trump of sabotaging Hudson Tunnel project for political reasons
stances.quote: President Trump tried to kill the single biggest transportation project in America — the Hudson Tunnel project — for nakedly political reasons, eliminating tens of thousands of jobs.

stances.summary: Accuses Trump administration of dishonesty
stances.quote: Well, they lied. Obviously.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump administration security failures as incompetence
stances.quote: From an operational security perspective, this is the highest level of fuckup imaginable. These people cannot keep America safe.

stances.summary: Questions Trump administration's FAA personnel firings
stances.quote: The flying public needs answers. How many FAA personnel were just fired? What positions? And why?

stances.summary: Denounces accidental firing of nuclear weapons managers as incompetence
stances.quote: Even worse incompetence: they accidentally fired, then apparently today un-fired, hundreds of the people who manage America's nuclear weapons.

stances.summary: Asserts courts, not Vice President, determine legality
stances.quote: In America, decisions about what is legal and illegal are made by courts of law. Not by the Vice President.

stances.summary: Accuses Trump administration of offering air traffic controller buyouts
stances.quote: They can't spin this away. The Trump administration contacted air traffic controllers, offering buyouts to leave their jobs. It's a very easily proven fact.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump for lying about FAA instead of leading on safety
stances.quote:
Despicable. As families grieve, Trump should be leading, not lying. We put safety first, drove down close calls, grew Air Traffic Control, and had zero commercial airline crash fatalities out of millions of flights on our watch. 
President Trump now oversees the military and the

stances.summary: Notes Republican and Trump chief of staff call him fascist
stances.quote: It’s one thing for some leftist group to call you a fascist. Quite another when it’s a fellow Republican. And absolutely astonishing when it’s your own chief of staff.

stances.summary: Argues intelligence briefings essential for national security
stances.quote: The president-elect should receive intelligence briefings not just as a courtesy—but as a matter of national security.

stances.summary: Criticizes Republican legislation increasing consumer bank fees
stances.quote: I am not making this up: Republicans have introduced legislation… to increase your bank fees.

stances.summary: Calls for defeating McConnell as Senate Majority Leader
stances.quote: In 6 weeks we can retire Mitch McConnell as Senate Majority Leader.

stances.summary: Opposes partisan use of federal property and taxpayer resources
stances.quote: Let's be clear: it is wrong and illegal to use federal property and taxpayer resources for partisan campaigning.

stances.summary: Argues postal service funding should transcend partisan politics
stances.quote: Some things should be beyond politics, like funding the post office.

stances.summary: Argues for bold structural reforms to broken political system
stances.quote: The fact that the system is broken is so obvious that it has become a cliché when politicians say it. So why aren't we taking the necessary big swings to fix it?

stances.summary: Suggests political leadership obscures public consensus on policy priorities
stances.quote: Most of us actually agree on the biggest things we must do to make life better in this country - despite what the people in power right now want you to believe.

stances.summary: Argues U.S. political system breakdown threatens American dream
stances.quote: The American dream is on the ropes, because the American political system has broken down. I talked with @The Diary Of A CEO about what needs to change in America today.

stances.summary: Calls for systemic political reform and bolder legislative action
stances.quote: We see that our political system is broken, then keep behaving as if it worked. We need serious change, and it's time to take bigger swings.

stances.summary: Argues political system reform needed for affordability
stances.quote: To make life easier and more affordable in this country, we must confront and fix what's wrong with our political system.

stances.summary: Calls for Congressional reform, Supreme Court reform, and campaign finance limits
stances.quote:
Fix Congress. Reform the Supreme Court. End money in politics. We cannot be afraid to fight for big reforms. 

Whether it’s paying more at the pump or struggling to afford a mortgage, kitchen-table problems will only be solvable when we deliver more accountability in government.

stances.summary: Challenges Speaker Johnson's record during campaign
stances.quote: Speaker Johnson has a lot to answer for when he's out campaigning and trying to earn your support this year.

stances.summary: Blames Trump's trade war and Iran war for American economic hardship
stances.quote: Whether it's a trade war with Canada or an actual war with Iran, the pattern is the same: Americans are paying the price for the President's choices.

stances.summary: Connects Biden's Inflation Reduction Act to subsequent inflation decline
stances.quote: Sure is interesting how we passed the Inflation Reduction Act, and then inflation went down.

stances.summary: Distinguishes stock market performance from overall economic health
stances.quote: The stock market is not the same thing as the economy.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump administration's economic record, job losses, manufacturing decline
stances.quote: The U.S. economy is officially losing jobs. From lost manufacturing to higher costs, the economic failures of the Trump administration keep piling up. There’s no way to spin these dismal results, because Americans know they’re paying the price every day.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump's indifference to inflation and cost of living
stances.quote: Who knows what the President meant when he said he loves the inflation - but it's clear that inflation keeps getting worse, while he stays focused on anything but the cost of living.  This is an election year! He may not be on the ballot, but his protectors and enablers in Congre

stances.summary: Attacks Trump-Vance administration for higher inflation despite cost-cutting promises
stances.quote: The Trump-Vance administration wants us to celebrate inflation rates that are *higher* than when they came into office. They promised to lower costs and keep us out of war, then did the opposite.

stances.summary: Argues wealthy nation can afford social programs
stances.quote: Don't let anyone tell us we can't have nice things - like good roads, schools, and health care - as if the world's richest nation couldn't possibly afford it.

stances.summary: Criticizes monopolies, argues systemic political reform needed
stances.quote:
Monopolies squeezing farmers. 

Consumers and workers squeezed on all sides.

Small businesses swamped by the big guys. 

Our economic reality will not change until we change what's wrong with our political system.

stances.summary: Compares opposition to mask mandates to opposition to seat belts
stances.quote: Being against mask mandates is like being against seat belts.

stances.summary: Criticizes U.S. COVID-19 outcomes as worst in developed world
stances.quote: Americans should not be satisfied with the worst COVID outcomes in the developed world.

stances.summary: Questions Trump administration's transparency on COVID-19 testing
stances.quote:
Why is Lindsey Graham refusing to take a Covid test? Is the President still on steroids? Where is the Vice President? 

How much better off would the USA be if we didn’t have to worry about questions like this?

stances.summary: Demands clarity on Trump's COVID-19 testing status
stances.quote: When was the president’s last negative COVID test?

stances.summary: Praises honest COVID-19 communication in other countries as life-saving
stances.quote: People in countries whose leaders told them the truth about COVID didn’t “panic.” They responded. And as a result, far fewer of them died.

stances.summary: Argues medical expertise should not be politicized
stances.quote: Listening to medical experts should not be political.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump for prioritizing Confederate statues over pandemic response
stances.quote: Imagine, for a moment, having a president more concerned with defeating this virus than protecting Confederate statues.

stances.summary: Equates denigrating service record to denigrating women's citizenship
stances.quote: Come to think of it, denigrating the worth of a soldier’s service based on whether he deployed to a war zone is… kind of like denigrating the worth of a woman’s citizenship based on whether she happens to have children.

stances.summary: Holds politicians accountable for inciting violence against LGBTQ community
stances.quote:
If you’re a politician or media figure who sets up the LGBTQ community to be hated and feared - not because any of us ever harmed you but because you find it useful - then don’t you dare act surprised when this kind of violence follows. 

Don’t you dare act surprised.

stances.summary: Condemns House Republicans' 2022 vote against marriage equality
stances.quote:
It’s 2022, and 157 House Republicans just voted against marriage equality.

That’s where they come down on this issue. 

In 2022.

stances.summary: Notes historic presence of same-sex spouse at Cabinet confirmation hearing
stances.quote: Having my husband @Chasten by my side yesterday in a hearing room is something not seen before for a Cabinet nominee. And our hope is that it makes it easier for the next person to come along.

stances.summary: States LGBTQ+ equality is central issue in election
stances.quote: We need to be clear with anyone who considers themselves an ally: LGBTQ+ equality is on the ballot.

stances.summary: Celebrates Supreme Court protection against LGBTQ workplace discrimination
stances.quote: Today, #SCOTUS has ruled that no LGBTQ American can be fired because of who they are or who they love.

stances.summary: Uses scripture to affirm LGBTQ acceptance and unity
stances.quote: “If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar.”

stances.summary: Argues Trump overstates popularity, underestimates public power
stances.quote:
Donald Trump is way less popular than he wants you to believe.

And you are significantly more powerful than he wants you to think.

stances.summary: Ridicules Trump's increasingly erratic campaign behavior
stances.quote: He’s really doubling down on the crazy uncle vibe this evening.

stances.summary: Condemns Trump's ambiguous directive to white supremacist group
stances.quote: Did the President of the United States just instruct a white supremacist group to “stand by”?

stances.summary: Questions Trump's financial obligations and potential conflicts of interest
stances.quote: Who does the president owe $421,000,000 to?

stances.summary: Questions what comes after Trump's political departure
stances.quote:
Donald Trump's departure from the political scene will come. 

The most important question is: then what?

stances.summary: Appeals to disillusioned Trump supporters, claims broken promises on wars and reform
stances.quote:
A lot of us know people - good people - who may have believed the promises they were told about "draining the swamp" or "no new wars."

Now is the time to reach out to them. Not to say, "I told you so," but to say, "He doesn't deserve you."

stances.summary: Attacks JD Vance as out-of-touch on housing market realities
stances.quote: It's hard to know what planet, let alone what housing market, JD Vance is living in, to be able to make such out-of-touch claims with a straight face.

stances.summary: Attributes mortgage rate increases, reduced construction, high rents to Trump tariffs and Iran war
stances.quote: Mortgage rates are way up. Home construction is down. Rents are astronomical. All of this is worse since Trump took power, because of the tariffs and the Iran War.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump for attempting to kill major U.S. transportation project
stances.quote: President Trump tried to kill the single biggest transportation project in America. Photo via Reuters

stances.summary: Argues wealthy nation can afford infrastructure, schools, healthcare despite claims otherwise
stances.quote: Don't let anyone tell us we can't have nice things - like good roads, schools, and health care - as if the world's richest nation couldn't possibly afford it.

stances.summary: Demands Trump support service members in Middle East war instead of insulting them
stances.quote: Our service members are paying the heaviest price for Trump’s new Middle East war. The very least he can do as Commander-in-Chief is support them, not insult them.

stances.summary: Criticizes Senate Republicans for blocking toxic burn pit benefits
stances.quote: Can’t believe we even have to say this, but: if you just went to the Senate floor and blocked benefits for veterans exposed to toxic burn pits while serving our country in a war zone, you are wrong.

stances.summary: Defends military service against derogatory characterizations
stances.quote: Americans who serve aren’t “suckers” or “losers” — they are patriots.

stances.summary: Demands Trump address reported Russian bounties on U.S. troops
stances.quote: 25 days and still waiting for the president of the United States to comment on reports of Russian bounties on our troops.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump for failing to support service members in Middle East war
stances.quote: Our service members are paying the heaviest price for Trump’s new Middle East war. The very least he can do as Commander-in-Chief is support them, not insult them.

stances.summary: Opposes new Middle East military intervention, criticizes war costs
stances.quote: If you’ve had enough of the White House sending America’s service members and tax dollars into an endless new Middle East war, while gas prices are going up here at home, welcome aboard.

stances.summary: Offers unsolicited policy advice to Trump on Iran strategy
stances.quote: If President Trump were to ask for my advice on Iran - not that I would expect him to listen - here is what I'd say:

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump's Iran war promises as false, opposes war costs
stances.quote:
When Trump said “I’m not going to start a war,” many Americans believed that promise - and voted for him.

When he said his Iran war would be over in a few weeks, many believed that too.

Americans today are fed up with the cost of this war - and the lies.

stances.summary: Calls for Russia to end invasion as peace condition
stances.quote: If Russia wants peace, they should end the invasion.

stances.summary: Criticizes Trump for not openly supporting Ukraine victory
stances.quote:
Donald Trump won’t say he wants Ukraine to win the war? 

I thought he would at least pretend….

stances.summary: Accuses Rubio of lying about ending war, criticizes administration credibility
stances.quote: I am not making this up: Secretary Rubio actually sat before Congress today and said “the war is over.” It’s a bizarre lie to tell when Americans know there’s obviously a war underway - not just from seeing it on screens, but from paying its costs every day at home.  Leaders with

stances.summary: Calls for universal condemnation of white nationalism and replacement theory
stances.quote: It should not be hard, especially today, for every elected official and media personality in America—left, right, and center—to unequivocally condemn white nationalism, “replacement theory,” and all that comes with it.

stances.summary: Demands respect for Civil Rights Act legacy
stances.quote: The Civil Rights Act was signed in 1964 by President Johnson. Show some goddamned respect.

stances.summary: Condemns Supreme Court rollback of civil rights, warns of gerrymandering
stances.quote: The Supreme Court has rolled back decades of hard-won civil rights progress. This decision will make Congress less representative for millions of Black Americans and others, and allow more politicians to pick their voters rather than the other way around. But this isn’t a moment

stances.summary: Opposes death penalty as fundamentally wrong
stances.quote: The death penalty is wrong. Always.

stances.summary: Implies Trump knowingly withheld information about serious matters
stances.quote: He knew. https://t.co/Aqn3C7TtIX

stances.summary: Demands independent investigation into federal agent use of deadly force
stances.quote:
We cannot accept the reckless use of deadly force by federal agents as normal.

There is a pattern of this administration misleading the public and withholding key facts after these killings. 

The public, and all who knew and loved the victim, deserve a full, independent investi

stances.summary: Argues judicial interpretation of law is necessary and valid
stances.quote:
Our Constitution is a living document because it requires real people to interpret laws written in a living language. 

If it were self-evident, judges would be unnecessary. 

Interpretation matters.

stances.summary: Prefers elected president to choose Supreme Court justice
stances.quote: My *preference* is that the winner of this presidential election should choose the next justice.

stances.summary: Campaigns for better future in South Carolina
stances.quote: Thank you, South Carolina, for such a warm welcome! It was inspiring to spend time with leaders and voters across the state who believe in building a better future.

stances.summary: Affirms women's reproductive rights and healthcare autonomy
stances.quote: We need to trust women to make their own health care choices. https://t.co/FNT7HEa020

stances.summary: Calls for Education Secretary who supports public education and health
stances.quote: We need a Secretary of Education who actually believes in public education...and public health.

stances.summary: Links white nationalist terrorism to gun violence, calls for action
stances.quote: Our country is under attack from white nationalist terrorism, inspiring murder on our soil and abetted by weak gun laws. If we are serious about national security, we must summon the courage to name and defeat this evil.

stances.summary: Condemns dehumanizing rhetoric toward immigrants and vulnerable groups
stances.quote: You do not refer to human beings as animals. You just don’t.

stances.summary: Emphasizes Democratic unity and broad voter agreement
stances.quote: Wherever you sit in this big tent of ours, remember just how much we agree on - with each other, and with a strong majority of voters.

stances.summary: Emphasizes faith and community resilience against hatred
stances.quote:
The story of Vernon AME is not only about confronting the destructive forces of hatred. It is a story about faith, hope, and community - an enormously inspiring one. 

“We are going to survive it, and we’re going to survive it together.”

stances.summary: Affirms majority support for affordable healthcare and public services
stances.quote:
You are not alone if you believe that every American should have access to good affordable health care and the best public schools.

You are actually part of an American majority.
